biotools.summary: CGRphylo is an R pipeline that uses Chaos Game Representation (CGR) to analyze SARS-CoV-2 lineages, strains, and recombinants. It offers a computationally efficient, alignment-free method for phylogenetic analysis and offers an R pipeline for visualization.
